_comment: Days to keep, by retention class. These are minimums from the spec (raw 380, derived 400) or longer where the math needs it: year-over-year transforms on monthly data need 365 days of lookback on top of the 400-day derived window, and annual/quarterly series are tiny, so they keep 10 years. Observations older than their class horizon are neither ingested nor kept. Edit and the next prune pass applies it.
